item.title: Port St. Lucie teen to serve as flag bearer at FIFA World Cup finals
item.description: Enrique Rosario Liz, named Southeast Region Youth of the Year by Boys & Girls Clubs of America, was surprised with a trip to serve as an official Coca-Cola flag bearer at the FIFA World Cup finals on July 19.

item.title: Port St. Lucie ranked 67th most stressed city in US, cited as 42nd most financially stressed
item.description: A new WalletHub study ranked Port St. Lucie as the 67th most stressed city in the United States, with the city cited as the 42nd most financially stressed in America.

item.title: Meth surge hits Palm Beach County as cocaine prices push users to cheaper drugs
item.description: Federal agents in Palm Beach County are reporting an unprecedented surge in methamphetamine, driven by rising cocaine prices. DEA agents seized about 54 kilos, nearly 120 pounds, of meth off Palm Beach County streets in just two days.

item.title: Karolina Muchova defeats Coco Gauff at Wimbledon to reach final after dramatic tiebreaker
item.description: Karolina Muchova ended Coco Gauff's Wimbledon run with a 6-2, 1-6, 7-6 (10) victory Thursday in a drama-filled tiebreaker.

item.title: 18th Annual Treasure Coast Seafood Festival Returns to Vero Beach in November
item.description:
The 18th Annual Treasure Coast Seafood Festival will return to Vero Beach this November, according to Under The Sun Promotions, Inc.
The event marks the 18th year for the seafood festival in Vero Beach. Under The Sun Promotions, Inc. is organizing the festival.
The announcement was made on July 6.

item.title: Florida's 32-day back-to-school sales tax holiday begins July 20, offering savings on clothing, supplies, and computers
item.description: Florida families can save hundreds of dollars during the state's annual back-to-school sales tax holiday running from July 20 through August 20. The 32-day tax-free shopping period covers clothing under $100, school supplies, computers, and educational items.

item.title: Port St. Lucie's 6,000-seat soccer stadium groundbreaking set for November
item.description: Port St. Lucie SC released new renderings of its stadium at the Walton & One development on U.S. 1 and Walton Road, with groundbreaking planned for November.

item.title: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse celebrates 165 years of guiding ships along Florida coast
item.description: The Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse has stood as a beacon for mariners along Florida's Atlantic coast for more than 165 years since its construction in 1860.
